tests.title: Section A: Applied Anatomy (37 marks)
tests.patternSource: INC B.Sc Nursing Regulations 2020, Appendix 3 (university theory question paper pattern): Applied Anatomy is Section A (37 marks) of a combined 3-hour, 75-mark paper shared with Applied Physiology (Section B, 38 marks). No internal choice. This mock covers Section A only, timed at about half the paper. Confirm with your university.
